Since some people seem to be saying it casually.

It's said that one overseas FX broker is withdrawing from the Japanese market. I had dealings with them from before they entered Japan, so I heard their side today, but whether the reason for this withdrawal will spread to the whole industry is hard to judge.

I hope it's the history-repeats pattern where they get pressured and decrease, then increase again.
